data.name: Katerine
data.gender_notes: Katerine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word καθαρός (katharos), meaning 'pure' or 'clear'. The name Katerine is often associated with the purity of the Blessed Virgin Mary in Christianity. This name also has biblical connections, as there was a woman named Catherine in the New Testament. The name Katerine carries the meaning “Pure, clear, and bright.” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Katerine usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear, and bright. and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity and clarity of the spirit.
data.etymology: Katerine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, clear, and bright..”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Katerine total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: קתרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור השם קתרינה הוא מן השפה היוונית ומשמעותו טהורה ונקייה ברוח ובנפש. השם קתרינה הוא שמה של קדושה חשובה בכנסייה הקתולית, הידועה באצולה ובחוכמתה. השם נמצא בשימוש נרחב במדינות רבות ומהווה סמל לטוהר ולקדושה.

in_greek.name: Κατερίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κατερίνη προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει καθαρή και αγνή ψυχή. Η Αγία Κατερίνη είναι μία από τις πιο σημαντικές αγίες στην Καθολική Εκκλησία, γνωστή για την πνευματική της σοφία και την αριστοκρατική της καταγωγή. Το όνομα Κατερίνη χρησιμοποιείται ευρέως σε πολλές χώρες και αποτελεί σύμβολο πνευματικής καθαρότητας και αγιότητας.

in_latin.name: Catherina
in_latin.meaning: pure and clean in spirit and soul
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Catherina originates from the Greek language and means pure and clean in spirit and soul. Saint Catherine is a prominent figure in the Catholic Church, renowned for her spiritual wisdom and noble lineage. The name Catherina has been widely used in many countries and represents a symbol of spiritual purity and holiness.

in_english.name: Katerine
in_english.meaning: pure, clean in spirit and soul
in_english.long_meaning: The name Katerine originates from the Greek word 'Aikaterine,' meaning pure, clean in spirit and soul. It is associated with Saint Catherine, a 4th-century martyr and philosopher, celebrated for her faith, intelligence, and courage. The name has been popularized across Christian cultures, symbolizing spiritual purity, wisdom, and nobility. Historically, Saint Catherine of Alexandria was a prominent figure in the early Christian church, known for her defense of the faith and her mystical marriage to Christ. The name Katerine has been borne by numerous saints, queens, and notable women throughout history, reflecting its enduring significance in Christian tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Katerine has been popular in various cultures, extending beyond its Greek origins. It has been adapted in several Western countries, as well as Eastern Europe and the Middle East. In each culture, the name is often associated with purity, elegance, or strength - traits reflecting the significance of the name's original meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: For many Christians, the name Katerine holds great spiritual significance as it is reminiscent of the Virgin Mary, a beloved and venerated figure within the faith. Numerous saints, including St. Catherine of Alexandria and St. Catherine of Siena, have also carried this name, further highlighting its religious connection. The name is often given to girls in the hopes of imbuing them with the virtues of purity, strength, and devotion, reflecting the spiritual ideals cherished by the Christian faith.
